notes: Budgets for backend/runner/src/terminals/manager.ts: scripts/ratchet/manager.test.ts fails when the file grows past one, and a raise goes only as far as the file needs, never leaving headroom. Set from main at a1fbfdaf (2026-10-17).

slack is how far under its budget the file may sit before the budget must come down. A change that removes a little passes and the test prints the number the budget could be lowered to, so everyday product work never edits this file (about a third of main's commits touch manager.ts, and concurrent pull requests would conflict here). Past the slack, as after an extraction, the test fails until the budget is lowered (in a change that touches manager.ts or this file; any other change only prints it, as two changes merged one after the other can leave the file past a budget neither crossed alone), so a large win is locked in. Lowering a slack needs nothing; raising one is written as a raised budget is, with why and where from.

lines counts the file's lines. methods counts every function the Terminals class defines in its body: methods, accessors, the constructor and properties set to a function or arrow expression, read from its syntax tree, so formatting never moves it.

New behaviour goes in a sibling module under backend/runner/src/terminals/, as closes.ts, opens.ts and naming.ts do, with the class calling it. Work that can't is raised in the same pull request, written { "budget": n, "reason": "why", "from": "#PR or commit" }.

lines.reason: Transcript redaction: three Terminals options (transcriptMs, transcriptShutdownMs, redactor) with their Omit entries, the redactor's construction, the restart's save once the earlier screen is shown, and the restore's once its replay ends; the rest is in saving.ts. Transcript sealing: two more options (sealer, transcriptKeyMs) with their Omit entries and construction, and the restore's open before the shell starts, less the re-save once restored, which sealing makes redundant. Inbox turn rows (+3): Bindings and murmur reach Inbox and the redactor, so the redactor is a local shared with Saves, plus the Bindings host's turns entry. Interrupted-turn notice (+2): the restore reads the saved turn flag through restored(), its import and the call; the logic is in terminals/interrupted.ts. Windows resume (+1): the shell's prompt tells the sampler, which on Windows lets go of the agent a fresh shell resumes only a sample later; the logic is in terminals/sampling.ts. Peer reports (+1): TerminalPeers reads each terminal's latest tell and done from Inbox, as the agents listing shows them; the logic is in messaging/peers.ts. Standing done (+9): Inbox changes, delivered messages and the person's prompts republish the terminal's `reported` summary field through Bindings.publishReported; the rule is `standingDone` in messaging/peers.ts, the logic in terminals/binding/facts.ts. Inbox dismiss (+6, +2 methods): the router reaches Inbox only through Terminals, so dismissAsk and clearAsks forward to it; the logic is in messaging/inbox.ts. open_agent model and effort (+9): the models option (its doc, Omit entry, field, default and the Calls host's entry) carries each harness's model list to the open call, as install does; the checks are in terminals/calls.ts and the lookups in harnesses/service.ts. Close asks (+19): the router reaches the agents' asks to close a terminal through two Terminals methods (closeAsks, answerCloseAsk), as requests and answerRequest, with their field, host entry, imports, and release and shutdown calls; the logic is in terminals/closeasks.ts and calls.ts. Handle order (+3): the handleOrder option with its doc and Omit entry, which tests set to give handle words in list order; the logic is in terminals/handles.ts and names.ts.

methods.reason: Inbox dismiss (+2): dismissAsk and clearAsks forward the router's calls to Inbox, which it reaches only through Terminals; the logic is in messaging/inbox.ts. Close asks (+2): closeAsks and answerCloseAsk, the router's two entries to agents' asks to close a terminal, as requests and answerRequest are; the logic is in terminals/closeasks.ts and calls.ts.
